title: PD Ultraman Link
native_title: ＰＤウルトラマン・リンク
overview:
The finishing blow for falling-block puzzle games!!
Simple rules! Super-powerful special moves!!

What is "PD"?
It stands for Polygon Dimension. It's the series name for new, cool characters made with polygons!!

The heroes of Ultraman square off against an army of monsters in a falling-block puzzle battle royale. Pick a polygon Ultra warrior or monster and drop colored pieces into your well, linking three or more of the same color to clear them. Hold on under pressure and you can still turn a match around with a big comeback.

- Head-to-head puzzle battles against the computer or a second player
- 1-2 players

落ち物パズルゲームにとどめの一撃!!
ルールは簡単! 必殺技は超強力!!

「PD」って何？
ポリゴンディメンションの略。ポリゴンで作られた、新しくてカッコイイキャラクターたちのシリーズ名なのだ!!
